get.description:
Deprecated - Use the new endpoints instead:.
  • `/server/options/datacenters` → get all datacenters
  • `/server/options/images/{datacenter}` → get all images inside a datacenter
  • `/server/options/image/{imageId}` → get all image properties

200.description: List of objects, each object represents a server

datacenter.description: key value pair with datacenter code and datacenter description, this also lists all the available datacenters (zones) in which a server can be created.

cpu.description: available CPUs count configuration for new server

ram.description: available ram size configuration for new server, values are in MB.

disk.description: available ram size configuration for new server, values are in MB.

diskImages.description: key based listing of available hard disk templates. listing is datacenter based. per key, a list of objects specifying the available hard disk templates is returned,

items.description: list contains only the hard disk templates from hard disk library that can be used as an OS disks.

description.description: short description for the hard disk image

id.description: unique identifier for the disk image, use this value when specifying disk image as os disk source

sizeGB.description: the size in GB of the image, selected disk size in new servers must be on of the available options greater or equel to this value

usageInfo.description: full description of the hard disk image
usageInfo.example: full description of the current OS CentOS 5.10

guestDescription.description: guest description content of the hard disk image

freeTextOne.description: first free text content of the hard disk image

freeTextTwo.description: second free text content of the hard disk image

traffic.description: listing is datacenter based. per key, a list of objects specifying the available traffic packages is returne.

networks.description: listing is datacenter based. per key, a list of objects specifying the networks is returned.

name.description: the network name, value is used when specifying network connection for a new server

ips.description: an array of ip address range information
